context: Marimekko (mosaic) chart showing global market share by industry segment, with column width encoding total revenue and row height encoding segment share within each industry.
first_impression: Clean, well-structured marimekko with an intentional colorblind-friendly palette and clear typographic hierarchy, though the bottom legend area appears cut off in the rendered output.
what_works: The Tol Bright palette (explicitly named in code) is a deliberate, colorblind-friendly choice — not default D3 colors — and the four colors are distinct and harmonious. Typographic hierarchy is clear: bold category labels at top, scaled percentage labels inside cells, and quieter axis/subtitle text; cell labels are conditionally suppressed when cells are too small, showing restraint.
what_doesnt: The legend and bottom axis label appear to be rendered below the visible viewport or overlapping with the revenue labels (both placed near y=750 in an 800px SVG with 80px bottom margin), making the color key unavailable to readers. A few cells at the bottom-right (e.g., Government 9%) are partially clipped, indicating the layout is slightly too tall for the rendered container.
